# Security policy

This repository currently contains a README, an ignore file, a license, and repository audit notes. It has no executable machine-learning project, package dependencies or deployed application.

Please do not disclose credentials, tokens, private files or exploit details in a public issue. If GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled for this repository, use **Security → Report a vulnerability**. Otherwise contact the maintainer through an existing verified private channel. Public GitHub issues can be used for ordinary documentation and configuration problems that do not include sensitive material.

The historical contents remain available through Git. This policy does not promise a fixed response time or imply that an automated vulnerability scan has been completed. When source code and dependencies are added, the testing and supported-version policy should be revisited.
